title: Train a stable softmax classifier
summary: A training service intermittently returns NaN and reports inconsistent gradients when batch size changes. Repair its numerical and update path.

title: Repair a reverse-mode differentiation engine
summary: A small differentiable simulator reuses intermediate values. Its current engine loses gradient contributions when branches meet. Complete the graph evaluator and reverse pass.

title: Implement tensor views and their backward scatter
summary: A tensor backend must expose transpose, slicing and broadcasting without copying storage. Implement the view boundary and its gradient transport.

title: Make training and evaluation state agree
summary: A model behaves differently after export because its normalization buffers and dropout mode are mishandled. Build a reproducible training/evaluation session.

title: Resume a correct AdamW training update
summary: A trainer must match a large batch while accumulating smaller batches, and preserve Adam state across updates. Repair the reduction, clipping and optimizer path.

title: Connect an image filter to backpropagation
summary: An image pipeline already evaluates filters but cannot train them. Implement receptive-field extraction and the backward transport needed by the optimizer.

title: Build an edge-safe tiled matrix operator
summary: A kernel planner needs correct outputs and reproducible operation counts before hardware benchmarking. Implement tiled multiplication and a transparent traffic model.

title: Recover training after a mixed-precision overflow
summary: A mixed-precision worker must preserve model state when any microbatch overflows. Implement the loss-scale controller and atomic update boundary.

title: Fit an activation replay plan into a memory budget
summary: A trainer has a chain of layers with uneven activation sizes. Build a planner that explicitly accounts for saved boundaries and replay storage.

title: Shard optimizer ownership without changing the update
summary: A distributed trainer is moving optimizer state off replicated workers. Implement ownership, weighted reduce-scatter and reconstruction while preserving a single-worker SGD result.

title: Build a reversible byte-pair tokenizer
summary: An ingestion service needs a tokenizer that can be trained on small shards and reproduce token IDs exactly. Implement merge training and lossless text transport.

title: Deduplicate training data without leaking evaluation text
summary: A training corpus contains duplicate records and fragments from evaluation material. Implement a small deterministic admission filter with auditable rejection reasons.

title: Pack language-model batches and score only valid targets
summary: An evaluator produces different perplexities when sequence length changes. Repair packing, boundary masks and token-weighted aggregation.

title: Choose a training plan under a compute budget
summary: A research scheduler must choose among proposed training runs using measured small-scale trends. Build a transparent fitting and budget-selection tool.

title: Audit a group-relative policy update
summary: A reasoning-model trainer reuses sampled responses across updates. Implement an auditable group-relative objective with response masking and sign-correct clipping.

title: Compare experiments without changing the question
summary: A researcher has retried runs, unmatched seeds and checkpoints from different budgets. Build a comparison tool that answers a fixed experimental question without test-set selection.

title: Investigate curvature, momentum and learning-rate stability
summary: A researcher needs a controlled test bed to distinguish curvature effects from stochasticity and optimizer state. Implement a replayable quadratic experiment runner.

title: Measure signal and sensitivity through a residual stack
summary: An architecture experiment needs comparable diagnostics across depth. Build a tiny residual-stack probe that distinguishes signal magnitude from input sensitivity.

title: Compare factorized output heads under a parameter budget
summary: An architecture study asks whether a smaller output head can preserve held-out likelihood. Build the factorized projection and a fixed-feature comparison tool.

title: Dispatch sparse experts without losing capacity accounting
summary: A sparse model’s router is balanced on average but drops work in individual batches. Implement deterministic top-k routing, capacity admission and observable expert execution.

title: Run a tiny training and transfer-learning experiment
summary: A small-data study needs a complete, inspectable training loop to compare feature learning, frozen-feature transfer and regularization. Implement the model and its experimental harness.

title: Detect a reward specification that favors the wrong behavior
summary: A policy evaluation dashboard reports better reward while actual task completion falls. Build a replay audit that exposes a repeatable-reward loophole.

title: Release comparison
summary: Two models answer the same batch of prompts before a release. Workers can retry, correct, or withdraw a label. Complete the component that turns their updates into a rollout decision.

title: Per-layer KV cache
summary: A decoder handles prompt prefill and incremental generation in separate calls. Complete the cache path for a supplied two-dimensional attention model.

title: Live continuous batching
summary: Your serving worker receives requests at different times. Wire the supplied model to a scheduler that admits new work while longer generations are still running.

title: Paged KV-cache allocator
summary: Requests grow one token at a time in a fixed physical memory pool. Implement reservation, logical addressing, and reuse when requests finish out of order.

title: Shared-prefix caching
summary: Several requests start with the same system prompt. Reuse compatible KV states while keeping each continuation and saved prefix independent.

title: Speculative decoding
summary: A small draft model proposes tokens in blocks. Complete the target verifier using supplied next-token distributions and deterministic random draws.

title: Blockwise attention
summary: An inference worker streams key/value blocks that cannot fit in a single score matrix. Compute one attention output while keeping the softmax stable as new maxima arrive.

title: Quantized linear inference
summary: A model exporter and a CPU inference worker must agree on a compact weight format. Calibrate output channels independently, run the layer, and serialize exactly what it stores.

title: Chat supervised fine-tuning
summary: A fine-tuning job is learning to echo user prompts. Build the data path from tokenized chat turns to a labeled training batch, and inspect exactly which tokens receive loss.

title: LoRA linear layer
summary: Extend a frozen projection with a trainable adapter, update it on one labeled example, and export a merged projection for serving.

title: DPO preference loss
summary: Train on preferred and rejected completions using scores from a policy and a frozen reference. Implement the masked objective and check its update signal at extreme margins.

title: Distributed data-parallel SGD
summary: A training job splits batches unevenly between workers. Implement rank-local gradients, their reduction, and synchronized updates. The browser simulates ranks; a two-process driver is included for local runs.

title: Paired statistical comparison
summary: Two releases answered the same questions. Estimate the improvement and its uncertainty when multiple questions share one source document.

title: LLM-judge validation
summary: A pairwise judge evaluates the same answers in both display orders. Audit it against held-out human labels and locate order sensitivity across tasks and answer lengths.

title: Transformer · translate with encoder–decoder attention
summary: An encoder has read a source sentence. A teacher-forced decoder receives a target prefix. Implement one encoder and decoder layer so that every target position can consult the entire source while seeing only its own target history. Return the decoder’s vocabulary scores for all positions.

title: GPT-2 · score a text continuation
summary: A language-model evaluator reports suspiciously good perplexity. Rebuild its miniature GPT-2 scoring path from token and learned position lookups through a supplied causal block to a tied output head. Score each next token against the preceding position.

title: LLaMA · assemble a rotary decoder block
summary: Score a short sequence using a width-two LLaMA-style decoder. Implement rotary queries and keys, a gated feed-forward branch, and the two pre-normalized residual updates. A fixed readout exposes the effect of your block on each next-token score.

title: DeepSeek-V3 · decode from latent KV into sparse experts
summary: A decoder worker keeps compressed attention history and a separate position key. After each attention read, route the token across a shared expert and selected routed experts. The load-balancing correction may change which expert runs without changing the weights used to mix its output.

title: ResNet · Route identity and projected shortcuts
summary: A small vision runtime exports a residual stage for two spatial resolutions. Implement both paths of the stage so a stride change samples the same input coordinates on each path. A negative residual can suppress an otherwise strong detector.

title: VGG · Execute a configurable 3×3 stage stack
summary: An image classifier stores its feature extractor as a stack of stages. A mistaken placement of pooling silently changes the receptive field. Implement its feature extractor and track each stage's shape for the classifier head.

title: U-Net · Align a decoder with a cropped skip
summary: A tile segmenter combines a coarse context feature with a fine encoder feature. Implement the expanding path and stitch the encoder skip to the correct coordinates. A one-pixel offset changes which objects are marked foreground.

title: Vanilla RNN · backpropagate through a delayed label
summary: A sensor sequence often receives a label only at its last timestep. Train a tiny recurrent predictor and expose the gradient that flowed all the way back to its initial state.

title: LSTM · carry hidden and cell state through padded streams
summary: Complete an LSTM inference worker that can pause for padding and later resume from exactly the state it last emitted. A user needs both the visible trace and the internal cell state for a continuation.

title: GRU · encode a chunked phrase with reset-before gating
summary: A phrase encoder gets tokens in network-sized chunks. Build the recurrent unit that compresses the phrase into a fixed vector and return a checkpoint after each incoming chunk. Splitting a phrase differently must preserve its final embedding.

title: Gated DeltaNet · implement the recurrent token mixer
summary: A streaming language-model worker runs a token mixer with a fixed-size matrix state. Implement the gated delta recurrence and its readout. The worker must be able to checkpoint the matrix and continue with new projected tokens.

title: VAE · train with a reparameterized latent
summary: A toy binary sensor autoencoder samples a latent before predicting the sensor reading. Wire its encoder, likelihood and optimizer together so a reconstruction error can update both the decoder and the approximate posterior.

title: GAN · alternate discriminator and generator updates
summary: A one-dimensional data generator is frozen whenever the discriminator trains. Implement both optimizers so a complete round moves the generator toward examples the newly updated discriminator would call real.

title: DDPM · corrupt a signal and run its reverse chain
summary: A diffusion experiment uses different noise schedules for training and sampling. Build both sides from a single schedule so the loss probe and the reverse sampler agree on what timestep t means.
